mapping.external_key_rule: editorial.external_key (e.g. ubud-hujan-locale) → import.externalKey id:ubud:<suffix> (e.g. id:ubud:hujan-locale); import.slug keeps editorial key
unsupported_in_import: why_visit / best_for (folded into shortDescriptionEn / tags where useful)
indicative activity USD amounts as first-class price rows
visit_duration_minutes / booking_recommended when null (omitted from detail blocks)
accommodation starRating / amenities / price_per_night when unverified
